blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — Nine graduates from universities in Cebu made it to the top 10 of the August-September 2026 Philippine Nurses Licensure Examination (PNLE), according to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC). Leading the Cebu contingent are Tisha Marie Beatrice Jacobo Duncano of Cebu Normal University (CNU) and Sheena Reena Patayon Oco of Cebu Doctors University (CDU), who tied for the fourth place with a rating of 91.60 percent. Meanwhile, Zia Casipong Sangcap from CNU clinched sixth place with a 91.20 percent rating.
